# Vault

Plain Markdown, readable in any editor or [Obsidian](https://obsidian.md). AI assistants read single notes on demand through `ws search` / MCP; nothing here is loaded in bulk.

| Folder | Holds | Write when |
|---|---|---|
| Tasks/ | one record per ticket or branch | starting and checkpointing work |
| Product/ | verified product behavior: features, environments, flags | you confirm how something works |
| Project/ | codebase map: modules, patterns, ownership | you learn where something lives |
| Runbooks/ | repeatable procedures | you do something twice |
| Analysis/ | saved deep analyses, indexed in [[Analysis/INDEX]] | an analysis took real effort |
| Runs/ | orchestration step logs (JSONL, written by `ws run log`) | automatically |

[[Learnings]] holds lessons (mistake → rule). [[Feedback]] holds user feedback on the workspace itself.
